meta.name: heznpc
meta.tagline: Building the ecosystem AI lives in
meta.bio: Curator of open-source infrastructure, research, and tools for the AI era.
meta.thesis: Five brand axes anchor the work: infrastructure (AirMCP), research (ploidy), trust (canary), traction (skillBridge), and signal (anvil). Around them sit five research programs, a stack of supporting tools, a lab of experiments, and an archive of what has already been learned.

projects.name: AirMCP
projects.description: One MCP server for the Apple ecosystem (272 tools, 29 modules). Core infra — per-call HITL, HMAC-chained audit, OAuth 2.1 + Resource Indicators, allowNetwork policy — is the differentiated layer.

projects.name: ploidy-research
projects.description: Cross-session debate protocol — same model, different context depths. PyPI ploidy 0.3.3. Paper + tool monorepo.

projects.name: canary
projects.description: Operator-machine observability — git state joined with Claude Code session transcripts. APL / MIP / PLR / UCP push-leakage metrics.

projects.name: anvil
projects.description: MCP tool that bundles commit → PR → CI-wait → merge into one atomic call. Published as @heznpc/anvil on npm.

projects.name: skillBridge
projects.description: Translates Anthropic Academy lessons across 33 locales with an inline Claude tutor (Puter.js). MV3 v3.5.39. CWS US-locale pending re-publication after icon redesign.

projects.name: statute-of-limitations
projects.description: Designing institutional forgetting for AI agent memory — authority expiry vs deletion. Bridge between Programs 1 and 4. Foundational to AirMCP memory governance.

projects.name: oncology
projects.description: Agent failure taxonomy — errors detected but action continues. Crosses Programs 1 and 2.

projects.name: ochre
projects.description: Desktop-metaphor analogue for AI-assisted authoring interfaces. Layer-1 simulations + 5 testable predictions.

projects.name: villagent
projects.description: Agent entity continuity — configuration-loss-as-death framing. Companion to ploidy at the entity level. Concept note.

projects.name: meta
projects.description: LLM-as-research-infrastructure — using Claude Code to study Claude Code. alt.CHI 2027 target.

projects.name: narcissus
projects.description: Narcissus loop — collaborative entrenchment as an emergent property of the human + AI interaction loop.

projects.name: coup
projects.description: Hierarchy calibration in multi-agent debate — C(P) and τ metrics. Concept note.

projects.name: eddy
projects.description: ADHD × AI — neurodivergent workflows as competitive advantage in multi-session work. Published with Zenodo DOI.

projects.name: lifespan
projects.description: Accumulation–renewal dilemma — substrate-independent theory linking confirmation bias, paradigm lock-in, and LLM context entrenchment. Bridges Programs 2 and 4.

projects.name: z-gap
projects.description: Convergence ≠ Communicability — stratified Platonic Representations at the NL-Code interface. TACL rolling.

projects.name: third-vertex-llm
projects.description: Korean as third vertex — breaks the language/head-directionality/cultural-cluster confound in Japanese- and Chinese-only LLM cultural-cognition studies.

projects.name: macaronic
projects.description: Polyglot LLM stack orchestration as literary code-switching. Concept note.

projects.name: habitus
projects.description: Bourdieusian companion to z-gap — habitus explains why convergent representations fail to produce mutual intelligibility.

projects.name: tidal
projects.description: The Asymmetric Tide — AI amplifies digital hoarding through structural default bias. ABM + 8-cloud audit. CHI / FAccT / CSCW 2027 fit.

projects.name: silo
projects.description: Three-layer bias model — encounter / save / retrieval. AI-mediated search creates confirmation-biased digital hoards.

projects.name: scatter-caching
projects.description: TSI (Tool Scatter Index) — cross-platform information distribution as an unmeasured hoarding dimension.

projects.name: elixir
projects.description: The Last Elixir — PRISMA review of hoarding-related behaviors in digital games.

projects.name: sediment
projects.description: Streak mechanics drive compelled production of low-quality digital content. Deposition / Compaction / Fossilization lifecycle.

projects.name: ai-slop
projects.description: Production-Detection Asymmetry — multi-format AI content pollution beyond video. CACM + Big Data & Society umbrella.

projects.name: emergence-paradox
projects.description: Substrate chauvinism — replaces consciousness / creativity / identity as load-bearing concept in AI-acceptance discourse. Reorienting to CHI 2027 after Inquiry SI deadline.

projects.name: aichemist
projects.description: Burning Lead for Gold — structural homology between alchemy and the AGI paradigm.

projects.name: babel
projects.description: Babel and Anti-Babel — scale-dependent coupled dynamics of fragmentation and excessive convergence. Companion to aichemist.

projects.name: ai-bubble
projects.description: AI-to-AI content loops as engagement-metric inflation isomorphic to four financial-fraud forms.

projects.name: analogic-appropriation
projects.description: Cross-cultural media study on children’s play and combat narratives across media eras. Under review (New Media & Society).

projects.name: pythia
projects.description: Divination systems as non-formal inference engines — functional convergence with LLMs.

projects.name: whetstone
projects.description: Productive vs unproductive friction in AI-augmented learning. Invariant functions of pedagogy.

projects.name: ProfileKit
projects.description: GitHub profile cards by URL. No ratings, no rankings — composable presentation only. (canonical at newtria/ProfileKit)

projects.name: profilekit-mcp
projects.description: MCP server over ProfileKit. URL-only, never inlines SVG.

projects.name: cairn
projects.description: Yakdo-style pictogram maps. Fewer landmarks by design.

projects.name: newtria-crossflow
projects.description: Cross-OS Shortcuts ↔ Power Automate bridge. v0.1 ships the verified tool.

projects.name: pc-health-check
projects.description: PC health checker for Korean banking whitelist constraints.

projects.name: ai-course-glossary
projects.description: Claude Code Skill plugin re-exposing skillBridge’s curated Anthropic Academy terminology. Companion to skillBridge.

projects.name: inertbox
projects.description: Untrusted-content boundary primitive — wraps external content (web pages, emails, tool output) in delimited “data not instructions” boundaries.

projects.name: dol-pin
projects.description: K-pop concert merch C2C rental marketplace — MVP only.

projects.name: cuk-sw-community
projects.description: University SW community + blog + course materials. Pre-launch debugging.

projects.name: kontest
projects.description: Cross-source contest aggregator — 4 KR + 3 global sources, dedupe, classify, Telegram push.

projects.name: mothball
projects.description: macOS Swift package — git-aware project archiver with sidecar manifest.

projects.name: gemma4-quiz
projects.description: Local Gemma / Ollama quiz tool. PDF → MCQ + short-answer via JSON schema.

projects.name: hello-project
projects.description: Hello! Project timeline visualization. Fanart, frozen.

projects.name: token_save
projects.description: LLM API cost-reduction checklist — prompt caching, structure, batch API, model tiering. Notes only.

projects.name: TR-archive
projects.description: Tales-Runner unofficial archive — character stats, change-ticket simulator, story viewer. heznpc is contributor.

projects.name: trashmonster
projects.description: AI waste classification game for kids. Frozen at newtria org.
